fit_reason: This listing is for the boat trailer only. The Sea Ray in one photo shows what it used to carry and is not for sale, so there is no boat or vehicle here for us to detail.
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the EZ Loader roller trailer. We detail boats and cars and come to you, so if you have a boat to sell down the road, we'd be glad to give you a quote on a pre-sale gelcoat polish and detail.
